title: Hinomori Shizuku — Brand New Style〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I'm glad we made it back in time for afternoon classes.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Me too. I had a feeling that today's shoot would drag on a bit, so I wasn't sure if we'd actually make it.

rows.Speaker: New First-Year A
rows.Line: Hey, which clubs are you guys gonna visit today?

rows.Speaker: New First-Year B
rows.Line: Today? I'm gonna visit the volleyball club!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
They're already visiting clubs.
That's so cute.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: We got used to things pretty quickly since it's not like much had changed for us...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: But I'm sure they're excited about experiencing new things and what lies ahead.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah. The ones who were newly admitted to high school are probably busy making new friends.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: But that can also be tough because of how this school also has a junior high attached to it. Not all groups and cliques are that welcoming.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, doesn't that also apply to second-years...?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes... You may already be acquainted with some people in your new class...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: But everyone's usually formed groups or circles based on their clubs and such by that point.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, not everyone's friends with each other. I see what you mean by it's sorta the same thing for second-years.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: She's become such good friends with Minori and Kohane, but Minori's now credit-based and Kohane's also in a different class...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: You wouldn't expect them to be friends at first glance, but they got along really well.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I'm sure Shii will be fine since she and her classmates seemed to have fun during the School Festival. Still...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Then, why don't we go take a peek at how she's doing?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes! She's with Saki and a few others!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Lemme see...
Oh, she's in the same class as Emu.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: She should be fine if she gets to be classmates with those two.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. They seem to be having fun.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: But it would be nice to know what they're talking about.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: If I listen a little more closely, maybe I can... Oh!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Shizuku, what are you doing here?
Wait, Momoi, you're here too...?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
There's the bell!
We gotta run, Shizuku!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
Seriously, what was she doing with Momoi just now...?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
I'm sorry, Airi.
I didn't mean to get caught while looking...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: To be fair, it isn't nice to eavesdrop.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: At the same time, it's natural for you to be worried about your little sister. Just make sure to explain everything later, okay?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Thank you for coming with me, Airi.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hehe. If I hadn't gone with you, I'm sure you wouldn't have even found her classroom.
